name: DomXssMicro
description: A micro-benchmark designed to evaluate detectors for DOM-based cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities.
reputation: A niche academic micro-benchmark cited in web-security research for evaluating DOM-based XSS detectors; adopted primarily in specialized security evaluations.
notes: Small, specialized dataset intended for static/dynamic vulnerability detector evaluation; non-LLM benchmark with limited examples and risk of overfitting to micro-benchmark patterns.
